caseNameFull: National Securities Corp. v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. H. Cecil Kil-patrick for petitioner. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Samuel 0. Clark, Jr., and Messrs. Se-wall Key, J. Louis Monarch, and Newton K. Fox for respondent. Mr. Irving M. Engel filed a brief, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied.
